slides.headline: Karnataka CM: 'No One Can Stop' Mekedatu Dam; TN Objects
slides.photo_credit: Photo: Sonamj28 / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.stat_label: What Karnataka Says Mekedatu Will Cost
bullets: Karnataka CM Shivakumar asks the Centre for final clearances
He calls it a drinking-water reservoir for Bengaluru
He says the reservoir will help Tamil Nadu too
slides.credit_line: Sources: PTI, IANS, Hindustan Times, Public TV

slides.stat_label: Mekedatu Storage Tamil Nadu Says Could Cut Flows
bullets: TN CM Vijay asked the PM on 7 Nov to withhold clearances
Vijay says Tamil Nadu farmers fear for their livelihoods
TN Congress's Tagore and DMK's Stalin oppose it too
slides.credit_line: Sources: ANI, ThePrint, Deccan Chronicle, Hindustan Times

slides.stat_label: Supreme Court Called Tamil Nadu's Mekedatu Plea Premature
bullets: The Central Water Commission had only allowed a project report
On 13 Aug 2026, Karnataka sent its report to the CWC
If the CWC approves it, Tamil Nadu may take legal steps
slides.credit_line: Sources: Supreme Court via LiveLaw, Indian Kanoon; PTI, IANS
